versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ArXiv Research Assistant Secure.
- Offers advanced ArXiv paper search with multi-keyword, author, and category filtering.
- Local caching supports offline access and reduced API calls.
- Integrates AI-based summarization of papers and abstracts.
- Research tracking features log papers to structured markdown with export options.
- Includes secure PDF download and local storage; no shell commands or exec used.
- Network access is restricted strictly to ArXiv with input validation for added security.
